description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' handling of external types, specifically testing serialization and deserialization of external enum types passed as parameters to grain methods. It defines the ExternalTypesTests class which includes a test method for verifying that grains can process external enum types correctly.

classes.name: ExternalTypesTests
classes.description: Unit test class verifying Orleans' handling of externally defined types such as enums passed to grains.

methods.name: ExternalTypesTest_GrainWithEnumExternalTypeParam
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that retrieves a grain and invokes a method passing an external enum type to verify serialization correctness.
